content_panel_hint.message: Threshold as a % of the Auto threshold (the estimated point where the model starts to forget). 100% = same as Auto. Lower = stricter: colors and % are calculated from this threshold. Example: a 10% threshold → yellow when Auto≈5%, red at Auto≈8%.

content_panel_auto_status.message: Auto threshold: $1 tokens (= 100% in the field)

options_limit_hint.message: Threshold as a % of the Auto limit: colors and % are calculated from this threshold. 100% = same as Auto. Empty = Auto

options_show_widget.message: Show the indicator on the page

options_autoexport_hint.message: Downloads the chat history once when the threshold is reached

options_proactive_levels_label.message: Notification and badge thresholds (1–100, ascending order):

options_proactive_hint.message: Each threshold fires once per conversation; invalid input falls back to the default 70/85/95

options_byok_key_placeholder.message: Enter your Google AI Studio API key

options_byok_hint.message: The key is kept only until the browser is restarted (chrome.storage.session). Enter it again after a restart.

options_exact_count.message: Exact token counting via the Gemini API

options_export_hidden_label.message: Include reasoning and injections of neighboring extensions (DeepSeek++, Better DeepSeek) in exports

options_export_hidden_title.message: Reasoning auto-included when present in source; toggle forces exclude

options_export_hidden_hint.message: Off: only questions and answers go into the file, without reasoning or injections of neighboring extensions (DeepSeek++, Better DeepSeek). On: reasoning and injections go into the export.

options_archive_hint.message: Local exports: Gemini Takeout (MyActivity.json), ChatGPT conversations.json, Claude conversations.json, Perplexity threads. Files are parsed in the browser (FileReader) and are never sent anywhere. The archive is the first tier: it defines the authoritative history floor and provides terminal archive-complete completeness.

privacy_s1_p1.message: AI Context Monitor is a browser extension that shows in real time how full the context window of AI models is (ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Claude, Perplexity, Google Search AI).

privacy_s1_p2_b.message: , on the user's device. The extension has no servers of its own: nothing is sent to the developer, shared with third parties, or used for analytics. All computations — token counting, history, export — run in the browser.

privacy_s3_li1.message: No telemetry, analytics or crash reports.

privacy_s3_li2.message: No reading of user cookies: cookies that already exist on AI service sites are used only by those sites themselves.

privacy_s3_li3.message: No requests to developer servers — the extension has no such servers.

privacy_s3_li4.message: No sharing of data with third parties.

privacy_s4_li1.message: All data is stored only on the user's device.

privacy_s4_li2.message: Limits and auto-cleanup: history stores at most 50 conversations; entries older than 30 days are deleted automatically. When importing archives — at most 20 files with a total size of up to 8 MB and up to 5000 messages per chat.

docs_page_title.message: AI Context Monitor — AI context window monitoring

docs_subtitle.message: Chrome extension for monitoring how full the context window of AI models is

docs_feature_indicator_title.message: Indicator in the corner of the screen

docs_feature_indicator_text.message: Shows in real time what percentage of the context window limit is used.

docs_feature_history_text.message: The conversation history is pulled automatically from the network, without scrolling the chat.

docs_feature_realtime_text.message: The percentage and the indicator color update with every new message in the conversation.

docs_feature_model_text.message: The model is detected automatically from the site data — no manual setup required.
